<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_Restaurant"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/restaurant-meal-ordering">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Order" name="Meal order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment made"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuzzerInfo" name="Buzzer and information: When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Ring" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Call" name="Guest called"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appear" name="Guest appears at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Meal" name="Meal handed over"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Guest_Process"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Restaurant_Process"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Order" name="Place order" messageRef="Msg_Order"
                      sourceRef="Send_Order" targetRef="Start_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Pay for meal" messageRef="Msg_Payment"
                      sourceRef="Send_Pay" targetRef="Task_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuzzerInfo" name="Hand over buzzer" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerInfo"
                      sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="Receive_BuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Ring" name="Buzzer rings" messageRef="Msg_Ring"
                      sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Catch_Ring"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Call" name="Call guest" messageRef="Msg_Call"
                      sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Catch_Ring"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appear" name="Appear at hatch" messageRef="Msg_Appear"
                      sourceRef="Send_Appear" targetRef="Catch_Appear"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Meal" name="Hand over meal" messageRef="Msg_Meal"
                      sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="Catch_Meal"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Guest process -->
  <bpmn:process id="Guest_Process" name="Guest" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Hungry" name="Guest feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Choose" name="Choose dish from meal range"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Wait" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Order" name="Place order with employee" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Pay" name="Pay for meal" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_BuzzerInfo" name="Receive buzzer" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Ring" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Ring" messageRef="Msg_Ring"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_GoHatch" name="Go to service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Appear" name="Appear at service hatch" messageRef="Msg_Appear"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Meal" name="Meal handed over">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Meal" messageRef="Msg_Meal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Eat" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Guest" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF1" sourceRef="Start_Hungry" targetRef="Task_Choose"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF2" sourceRef="Task_Choose" targetRef="Task_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF3" sourceRef="Task_Wait" targetRef="Send_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF4" sourceRef="Send_Order" targetRef="Send_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF5" sourceRef="Send_Pay" targetRef="Receive_BuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF6" sourceRef="Receive_BuzzerInfo" targetRef="Catch_Ring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF7" sourceRef="Catch_Ring" targetRef="Task_GoHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF8" sourceRef="Task_GoHatch" targetRef="Send_Appear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF9" sourceRef="Send_Appear" targetRef="Catch_Meal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF10" sourceRef="Catch_Meal" targetRef="Task_Eat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="GF11" sourceRef="Task_Eat" targetRef="End_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Restaurant process (Employee and Chef lanes) -->
  <bpmn:process id="Restaurant_Process" name="Restaurant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restaurant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPOS</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Payment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Aware</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_HatchMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EventGW_Hatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Appear</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_Timer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Meal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Prepare</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformEmployee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Order" name="Meal order placed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Order" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Payment" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_SetBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer to guest" messageRef="Msg_BuzzerInfo"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Prepare" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PlaceHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InformEmployee" name="Inform employee that meal is in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Aware" name="Become aware that meal is ready"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Msg_Ring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HatchMerge" name="Guest at hatch or call"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="EventGW_Hatch" name="Guest reacts?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Appear" name="Guest appears at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Appear" messageRef="Msg_Appear"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Timer" name="5 minutes elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_5min">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_CallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Msg_Call"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal" messageRef="Msg_Meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Meal" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF1" sourceRef="Start_Order" targetRef="Task_EnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF2" sourceRef="Task_EnterPOS" targetRef="Task_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF3" sourceRef="Task_Payment" targetRef="Task_SetBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF4" sourceRef="Task_SetBuzzer" targetRef="Task_HandBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF5" sourceRef="Task_HandBuzzer" targetRef="Task_InformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF6" sourceRef="Task_InformChef" targetRef="Task_Prepare"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF7" sourceRef="Task_Prepare" targetRef="Task_PlaceHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF8" sourceRef="Task_PlaceHatch" targetRef="Task_InformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF9" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployee" targetRef="Task_Aware"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF10" sourceRef="Task_Aware" targetRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF11" sourceRef="Task_SetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_HatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF12" sourceRef="Task_CallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_HatchMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF13" sourceRef="Gateway_HatchMerge" targetRef="EventGW_Hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF14" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Catch_Appear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF15" sourceRef="EventGW_Hatch" targetRef="Catch_Timer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF16" sourceRef="Catch_Timer" targetRef="Task_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF17" sourceRef="Catch_Appear" targetRef="Task_HandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="RF18" sourceRef="Task_HandOverMeal" targetRef="End_Meal"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
